capabilities: Set a custom vault display name without renaming the folder
Reorder vault name and document name in the app title
Add a vault switcher context menu item for quick nickname changes
Assign the vault's parent folder name as a default nickname
disambiguation: Does not rename the vault's folder or files; it only changes the name Obsidian displays.
extras: The plugin must be installed in every vault whose nickname should be visible, since plugins only affect the UI of vaults where they are installed; a backwards-compatibility setting saves extra data for versions earlier than 1.1.9.
motivation: The author built it to disambiguate vaults that share the same folder name, which is common for users adhering to a standard file structure between multiple projects.
problem: Obsidian identifies vaults by their folder name, which is ambiguous when multiple projects use a common folder structure and thus share the same folder name.
summary: Vault display-name override that sets a custom nickname for a vault in the app title and vault switcher without renaming its folder.
